description: This file contains utility functions for the game logic of a Tic Tac Toe game, including defining winning lines and functions to determine the game winner and check if the board is full.

methods.name: calculateWinner(squares)
methods.description: Determines the winner of the current board by checking predefined winning line combinations.

parameters.name: squares
parameters.description: Array representing the current state of the game board with 'X', 'O', or null.

methods.name: isBoardFull(squares)
methods.description: Checks if the game board is completely filled with no remaining null values.

parameters.name: squares
parameters.description: Array representing the current state of the game board.
